evaluation.normalization: Unicode NFKC; trim; collapse whitespace; case-sensitive

T1a_ACRONYM.semantic_scope: same extractive target; no answer-format example, summary request, explanation request, or added reasoning requirement

T2_NUMERIC.semantic_scope: same extractive target; no answer-format example, summary request, explanation request, or added reasoning requirement

T3_CLAIM.semantic_scope: same extractive target; no answer-format example, summary request, explanation request, or added reasoning requirement

T1a_ACRONYM.TEMPLATE_0_PRIMARY: What does {SHORT_FORM} stand for in the passage? (frozen per-instance original instruction)
T1a_ACRONYM.TEMPLATE_1: Identify the full form of {SHORT_FORM} from the passage.
T1a_ACRONYM.TEMPLATE_2: According to the passage, expand the abbreviation {SHORT_FORM}.

T2_NUMERIC.TEMPLATE_0_PRIMARY: According to the passage, what value is reported immediately after {ANCHOR}? (frozen per-instance original instruction)
T2_NUMERIC.TEMPLATE_1: According to the passage, what value is reported for {ANCHOR}?
T2_NUMERIC.TEMPLATE_2: Extract the reported value for {ANCHOR} from the passage.

T3_CLAIM.TEMPLATE_0_PRIMARY: Extract the scientific finding stated in the passage. Preserve the wording, conditions, polarity, negation, and uncertainty expressed in the evidence. (frozen per-instance original instruction)
T3_CLAIM.TEMPLATE_1: Extract the scientific finding expressed in the passage. Preserve all stated conditions, polarity, negation, and uncertainty.
T3_CLAIM.TEMPLATE_2: Return the scientific claim stated in the passage using its original wording, including any explicit conditions and uncertainty.
